emily: Quick flag \/\/- weekly KPI deck shows launch content driving a lot more leads but CAC is up and pipeline isn't tracking. dash: https:\/\/app.redwood.com\/dash\/launch-bench
marco: saw that. are we double-counting the quick sign-up flow?
olga: maybe also a routing rule change? last-week we tweaked the lead scoring threshold for demo routing.
product-marketing: we A\/B tested messaging variants — variant B had a lower gating question that often yields low-intent leads. could explain quality drop.
crm-bot: [auto] routing-rule-change detected: demo_threshold lowered from 70 to 60 at 3165009000 by marco
analytics-bot: [auto] anomaly: campaign_attributed MQLs +48% WoW; conversion to SQL +6% WoW; cohort: last 7 days
emily: ok — hypothesis: messaging change (more permissive) + routing threshold drop = volume up but quality down. need to avoid celebrating headline uplift
marco: putting demo_threshold back to 70 now. holding any paid budget increases until we validate adjusted metrics.
olga: i'll run a quality backtest: split by messaging variant, device, and routing tag. will post a CSV sample.
product-marketing: for the benchmark narrative: propose calling this out explicitly in the executive slide — "volume uplift driven by less restrictive gating and routing change; adjusted funnel shown for apples-to-apples"
emily: agree. action items: (1) revert routing (marco) (2) quality backtest + CSV (olga) (3) dual-metric KPI slide (raw vs adjusted) (product-marketing) (4) pause paid scale decisions until backtest (emily)
marco: reverted routing at 3165012355 — logging ticket #PM-452
olga: uploading sample: https:\/\/uploads.redwood.com\/tmp\/launch-quality-3165012345.csv
analytics-bot: [reminder] Weekly KPI review tomorrow 9:00am PT \/ attach adjusted funnel and bench note
emily: thanks team. i'll draft the bench paragraph and add a slide with both numbers and the routing change note. we'll discuss in the KPI huddle. :thumbsup:
